items.distractor_fact: Сусідня метеостанція того самого ранку зафіксувала показник {D}°C.
items.gloss_en: A neighboring weather station recorded a reading of D°C that same morning.
items.entity_note: A different weather station than the one whose morning/evening readings the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Акції іншої компанії того самого дня коштували {D} $.
items.gloss_en: Shares of a different company cost D $ that same day.
items.entity_note: A different company's stock, not the one whose opening/closing price the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Рівень води в сусідній річці того самого ранку був на позначці {D} м.
items.gloss_en: The water level in a neighboring river was at a mark of D m that same morning.
items.entity_note: A different river than the one whose morning/evening level the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Інший дрон на сусідньому маршруті тримався на висоті {D} м.
items.gloss_en: Another drone on a neighboring route was flying at an altitude of D m.
items.entity_note: A different drone on a different route, not the one whose two route points the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Вага іншої посилки в тому самому відділенні становила {D} кг.
items.gloss_en: The weight of a different parcel at the same branch was D kg.
items.entity_note: A different parcel, not the one being repacked.

items.distractor_fact: Радар на сусідній трасі того самого дня зафіксував швидкість іншого автомобіля {D} км/год.
items.gloss_en: A radar on a neighboring road recorded another car's speed as D km/h that same day.
items.entity_note: A different car measured by a different radar on a different road, not the two posts the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: На інший рахунок того самого дня було внесено {D} $.
items.gloss_en: D $ was deposited into a different account that same day.
items.entity_note: A different account, not the one whose balance the question computes.

items.distractor_fact: Дохід сусідньої крамниці за той самий місяць становив {D} $.
items.gloss_en: A neighboring shop's income for the same month was D $.
items.entity_note: A different shop, not the one whose net result the question computes.

items.distractor_fact: У тій самій турнірній таблиці іншій команді в графі «Закинуто» записано {D}.
items.gloss_en: In the same tournament table, another team's entry in the "Scored" column is D.
items.entity_note: A different team's row in the same table, not the team whose goal difference the question computes.

items.distractor_fact: Інший цех того самого дня виготовив {D} кг продукції.
items.gloss_en: A different workshop produced D kg of goods that same day.
items.entity_note: A different workshop with its own unstated production target, separate from the plan given in the story.

items.distractor_fact: Інший магазин продав товарів на суму {D} $ за той самий тиждень.
items.gloss_en: A different shop sold goods worth D $ over the same week.
items.entity_note: A different shop with its own unstated sales plan, separate from the plan given in the story.

items.distractor_fact: У сусідньому районі того самого дня випало {D} мм опадів.
items.gloss_en: In a neighboring district, D mm of rain fell that same day.
items.entity_note: A different district with its own unstated forecast, separate from the forecast given in the story.

items.distractor_fact: У картці іншого гравця в графі «Ударів» для іншої лунки записано {D}.
items.gloss_en: In another player's scorecard, the entry in the "Strokes" column for a different hole is D.
items.entity_note: A different player and a different hole, whose par is not stated, separate from the pair the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Потяг іншого маршруту прибув того самого ранку, і час прибуття становив {D} хв після півночі.
items.gloss_en: A train on a different route arrived that same morning, and the arrival time was D minutes after midnight.
items.entity_note: A different train route with its own unstated schedule, separate from the train the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: На панелі іншого ліфта поверх, де він зупинився, позначений числом {D}.
items.gloss_en: On a different elevator's panel, the floor where it stopped is marked with the number D.
items.entity_note: A different elevator with its own unstated ground-level reference, separate from the elevator the question compares.

items.distractor_fact: Того самого дня в місті Харкові термометр показав {D}°C.
items.gloss_en: That same day, in the city of Kharkiv, the thermometer showed D°C.
items.entity_note: A third city, neither Lviv nor Odesa, the two the question compares.
